ABOUT

Who are we? What is Creative Labs?

We connect students from all disciplines and backgrounds together to bring any creative passion project to life! Creative Labs started as a small group of friends and is founded on the idea that with the right group of people, any idea can come to life. Let’s make something cool together!

ABOUT CREATIVE LABS

➔

How do we operate?

We have two main components: internal board and external projects. The internal board is responsible for running things behind the scenes like hosting events, socials, and workshops (which are open to everyone)! External projects work together in teams to complete and execute any creative idea by the end of the quarter.
